# Lauralu Industry

> > Lauralu provides temporary and semi-permanent industrial buildings, warehouses, and modular structures across the UK & Ireland, engineered to NV65 and Eurocodes standards for weather-resistant, compliant solutions.

Lauralu specializes in hire and sale of demountable aluminum-frame structures for industrial storage, construction, education, agriculture, and specialized applications. All buildings comply with UK Building Regulations 2010, CDM 2015, and BS EN 1090 standards, offering flexible expansion solutions for businesses requiring temporary or permanent capacity.

## Key Topics

- Temporary buildings and structures
- Industrial warehouses and storage
- NV65 and Eurocodes compliance
- Weather-resistant structures
- Modular construction
- Building Regulations 2010
- CDM 2015 (Construction Design and Management)
- Demountable buildings
- Aluminum frame structures
- Insulated and semi-permanent buildings
- Temporary building hire vs purchase
- Site preparation and groundworks
- Health and Safety compliance
- BS EN 1090 certification
